blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine Coast Guard Rear Adm. Jay Tarriela on Monday pushed back against a Chinese academic’s claim that the Philippines had illegally occupied a disputed Shoal, sparking a sharp exchange underscoring the tensions surrounding the South China Sea dispute. Zheng Zhihua of Shanghai Jiaotong University made a point about the “fundamental differences” on the South China Sea issue and brought up that China had shown restraint by using only water cannons to defend what he called its territorial integrity, citing Second Thomas Shoal—known as Ayungin to the Philippines and Ren’ai Jiao to China—as an example. “China think[s] the Philippines […]...
